result.markdown:
If you want to explore real-world, user-submitted prompt examples and showcase artifacts for **Claude Opus 5.5** and **Claude Sonnet 5.5**, several dedicated community libraries, platform docs, and discussion spaces track them actively:

### 1. Dedicated Prompt & Demo Libraries
* **YouMind (Opus 5.5 Motion Prompts):** A dedicated gallery tracking code-generated animations, kinetic sculptures, 3D WebGPU scenes, and UI components built with Opus 5.5.[youmind.com](https://youmind.com/opus-5-5-prompts#:~:text=Build%20a%20painted%203D%20world%20in%20the,By%40An%20Nayalyesterday.%20View%20full%20prompt%20%26%20copy.) Each entry includes the original prompt and breakdown.[youmind.com](https://youmind.com/opus-5-5-prompts#:~:text=%E2%80%A6%20Use%20this%20prompt.%20By%40dodo2137yesterday.%20View%20full,days%20ago.%20View%20full%20prompt%20%26%20copy.)
* **AIIdeList & ExplainX Showcases:** Curated technical blogs and breakout articles (such as *Claude Opus 5.5 Examples: 8 Real-World Demos*) document full-stack use cases, ranging from generative Three.js code and multi-agent refactoring to long-horizon software migrations.[aiidelist.com](https://aiidelist.com/blog/claude-opus-5-5-examples#:~:text=They%20involve%20long-running%20agent%20work%2C%20code-generated%20visual,scaffolding%2C%20tools%2C%20and%20human%20intervention%20can%20vary.)

### 2. Developer & Social Communities
* **Reddit (`r/ClaudeAI` and `r/ClaudeCode`):** Look for recurring megathreads like *"Lets see your best prompts for the new Opus 5.5 motion videos"* or discussions detailing Sonnet 5.5 agentic setups. Users frequently share raw prompt text for code-built interactive apps, pixel art loops, and UI design.
* **X (formerly Twitter):** Following tags like `#ClaudeOpus` or reviewing shared builds from developers and designers yields direct-to-source demonstrations (such as generative physics engines, canvas-based art, and automated repo migrations) where prompt parameters are often shared in the replies.

### 3. Official Resources
* **Anthropic Platform & Prompt Engineering Docs:** Anthropic publishes official prompt guidelines specific to Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 behavior—including strategies for thinking effort tokens, tool use, and structured JSON output.[platform.claude.com](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompting-claude-sonnet-5-5)
